stories.title: Watson tapped to start Browns' preseason opener
stories.summary: The Browns will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in their preseason opener Saturday in Chicago, and Shedeur Sanders will start the second preseason game at home against the Bills.

stories.title: Westbrook retires from NBA after 18 seasons
stories.summary: Russell Westbrook, who played 18 NBA seasons with seven teams, announced his retirement Wednesday.

stories.title: Sources: Kushner, Iger to buy Lakers for $12.5B
stories.summary: The Lakers are being sold to businessmen Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for $12.5 billion, a record-breaking price, multiple sources told ESPN.
